text.zh-TW: 取自平台分享文案；實際內容與期限以 OKX 官方公告為準。
text.en: Taken from the platform's share text; actual terms follow OKX's official announcements.

steps.zh-TW: 點擊「立即註冊」開啟推薦連結（推薦碼 CHFYPQCK 已包含在連結中）。
steps.en: Select “Sign up” to open the referral link (referral code CHFYPQCK is already part of it).

steps.zh-TW: 依頁面指示註冊 OKX 帳號；若註冊時要求推薦碼，請輸入 CHFYPQCK。
steps.en: Register an OKX account as the page asks; if it asks for a referral code, enter CHFYPQCK.

steps.zh-TW: 依活動規則完成任務後領取獎勵（最高 100 USDT）。
steps.en: Complete the tasks under the campaign rules and claim the reward (up to 100 USDT).

intro.zh-TW: 點擊推薦連結註冊 OKX，即可獲取最高 100 USDT 的獎勵。
intro.en: Sign up for OKX through the referral link to receive rewards of up to 100 USDT.

description.zh-TW: OKX（歐易）是加密貨幣交易所。這個邀請連結的網址結尾就是邀請碼 CHFYPQCK；註冊時若畫面要求推薦碼，請自行填入這組代碼。平台分享文案提到最高 100 USDT 的獎勵，需依活動規則完成任務後領取，實際內容與期限以 OKX 官方公告為準。註冊前先確認網址列的網域與官方網站一致。
description.en:
OKX is a crypto exchange. The referral link on this page ends with the referral code CHFYPQCK; if the registration page asks for a referral code, enter it exactly as shown.

The platform's share text mentions rewards of up to 100 USDT, which are claimed by completing tasks under the campaign rules. Actual terms follow OKX's official announcements. Before you enter personal details, confirm that the domain in the address bar matches OKX's official website.

notes.zh-TW: 推薦碼 CHFYPQCK 已包含在連結中；手動輸入時請依原樣。請自行確認所在地區的法規與平台服務範圍。
notes.en: Referral code CHFYPQCK is already part of the link; if you type it in, enter it exactly as shown. Check your local regulations and whether the platform serves your region.
